name: Me
source:
A girl coming to ward 13 to work as a teacher after receiving her teaching license. Besides giving normal lessons, she sets out another goal to fulfill all of her four students' wishes before school closure in 4 months.

[spoiler]It was not after Sakai-san's death did her casual school life undergo a drastic change. Many things get unveiled, questions left unanswered, till this day. The reason behind her amnesia, the 2014 incident, and above all, Mirai's wish of searching for a certain "book"... An adventure begins, as she decided to pursue the answers to everything.[/spoiler]

Despite being hard-headed sometimes, the protagonist is a caring, emotional girl. She loves drinking strawberry milk and listening to radio with [url=/c91252]Mirai[/url] in her meantime. In the school, she would play catch with her students after class is over.

Later on, her name is revealed to be [spoiler]Inamori Alice[/spoiler].
